subtitle: virtual element method
body: Recently stumbled upon a paper by Sutton, who implemented the virtual element method for the two-dimensional Poisson problem in exactly fifty lines of MATLAB.
I've always wanted to go deeper into numerical computing and meshing, and never quite found the time since it's such a dense topic.

Looking at this through the lens of stubbornness and blissful naivety, this feels like the perfect opportunity to start frictionless, implement this paper myself, and go through each line, trying to understand the concepts.
